basics.name: Kate Hamada
basics.label: Student
basics.summary: Computer Science senior (graduating Spring 2027) with internship and practical experience in full-stack web development and data analytics. Combines strong technical abilities across software engineering, UI/UX, and data analysis with clear communication and a fast-learning mindset.

work.summary: Using Python, PostgreSQL, and Tableau to analyze energy and water data and translate it into environmental insights in order to help shape Sea Grant's sustainability roadmap.
Deployed a full-stack web application and relational database designed to collect, process, and analyze user-inputted data in real time.

I was part of the spring 2026 cohort and was assigned to work with HDCP (Hawaii Data Climate Portal) on the climate atlas for evapotranspiration. Where I developed a website that took ascii files and turned them into json files which were then displayed onto a map using typescript.

volunteer.summary: Encouraged kids to stay in shape for other sports as well as giving them advice on how to get faster.
